intro_html: This is the bowl for when you want something that feels a little lighter but still fills you up. Lean beef and tender broccoli over rice, pulled together with a splash of beef broth and a melt of cheddar. Real vegetables, real protein, and it still lands right around $3.13 a bowl (at everyday cost). Your future self, opening the fridge on a busy Tuesday, will thank you.
cost_closing_html: About $3.13 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a balanced, veggie-loaded dinner. Frozen broccoli keeps this cheap and fast year round.
portion_html: Set the full pot on your scale and subtract the empty-pot weight from Step 1. Divide that total by 14 and scoop the exact amount into each container. Every bowl lands near 389 calories and 34 grams of protein.
upsell_html: Balanced dinners for about $3.13 a bowl (at everyday cost). This is one of many. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons, calculators, and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Frozen broccoli beats fresh here. It is cheaper, lasts for months, and cooks straight from the bag with no waste.
Buy the beef on sale and freeze. The one rule that quietly lowers the cost of every batch you make.
Broth in a big carton is cheaper per cup than the little cans, and it keeps in the fridge for your next few batches.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Cook the rice. Three and a half cups dry jasmine with water per the package, then set aside.
Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up. Drain any excess.
Add the broccoli and the beef broth, cover, and steam a few minutes until the broccoli is bright and tender.
Combine the rice, beef, and broccoli in your big pot and stir. Fold in the shredded cheddar.

head.description: A lean beef, broccoli, and rice meal prep bowl with cheddar. Fourteen servings at about 389 calories and 34 grams of protein for roughly $3.13 each (at everyday cost).
head.keywords: high protein meal prep, cheap meal prep, beef and broccoli, budget dinner, veggie meal prep
steps: Cook 3.5 cups dry jasmine rice per the package and set aside.
Brown the ground beef in a large skillet and drain any excess.
Add the broccoli and beef broth, cover, and steam until tender.
Combine rice, beef, and broccoli and fold in the cheddar.
Weigh the batch and divide into 14 containers.
